{{Quote|Oh, this was years before you were born, kid! That place was full of all kinds of resources! We would have made a killing were it not for those danged apes! The '''Veermok Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] nestled within the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] near [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:VC" /> During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the cave was an ore mine operated by the [[Jandosan Mines]]. However, all mining activities were stopped when a pack of giant [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]] overtook the cave. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the veermoks still lived in the abandoned mine.<ref name="SWG:ac" /> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ronin Lightrunner]] who studied the veermoks once gave a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] the coordinates to the cave.<ref name="SWG:RL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Ronin Lightrunner|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Veermok Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:VC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
